text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Kipling Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to recommend that the easterly northbound curb lane on Kipling Avenue, from Steeles Avenue West to a point 30.5 metres south, be designated for northbound right turns only. The proposed lane designation will clearly define lane usage and mitigate any potential vehicular conflicts.

City Council on October 8 and 9, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council designate the easterly northbound lane on Kipling Avenue, between Steeles Avenue West and a point 30.5 metres south, for northbound right turns only, buses excepted.
